description: List MCP servers from the MCP Registry with optional pagination. Returns raw server data for semantic analysis.

limit.description: Maximum number of servers to return (1-100, default: 50)

registry_url.description: Base URL of the MCP Registry API (defaults to official registry - https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers)

name: list_mcp_servers
